author: Zintenka
body:
Hey, I'm looking for an active team. I'm a really good PVPer using conventional and non-coventional tactics. I believe that the use of anything in PVP to win is needed.

I'm an all-rounder. I can play middle, rush (My least strength), and defense very well. I can adapt to most situations well and I try my best to improve.

I'm active enough to be a lot of help to my team. I can do anything that you need me to do. Armor crafting, defense, TNT warfare (If the map has it), archery (Exemplar).

I can bow spam very well and do sword combos good enough. Thank you!
